howto.name: Upload a WebP image
howto.text: Select a WebP file. PNG conversion preserves transparency if the original has any.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. The result is a lossless PNG, typically 3–5x larger than the WebP source but universally compatible.

faq.a: PNG is lossless and supports transparency, making it ideal for graphics, logos, screenshots, and anywhere you need pixel-perfect output.

faq.q: How much larger is the PNG?
faq.a: Typically 3–5x the size of the WebP source. PNG compression is lossless but less efficient than WebP.
Yes. Transparent pixels in the WebP come through unchanged in the PNG.
